body.name: Front
body.def: For \(c=t/(1-t)\) and \(0<t<1\), \(\mathfrak F_{r,b}(v)(t)=(1+c)\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}r_j[\Psi_{c,b_j}(Rv_j)-b_j^{\top}Rv_j]\); at \(t=0\), it equals \(\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}r_j[\max_{a\in\mathcal A}(Rv_j)_a-b_j^{\top}Rv_j]\); and at \(t=1\), it equals \(\frac12\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}r_jv_j^{\top}R^{\top}C(b_j)Rv_j\)
body.role: compactified welfare-gain frontier computable at supplied weights and contrasts
